page.overview:
What is Abrogator?

Abrogator was an Imperial Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that acted as the flagship of the fleet sent to Saloch 2 to quell a group of Lortans during the Reslian Purge.

The sixth squadron of the 37th Imperial Fighter Wing was assigned to the Abrogator, under the command of Captain Lun Tessra. Lieutenant Soontir Fel was posted to the squadron after graduation from the Imperial Academy, and eventually rose to command the unit.
